build: MRT Pharma True First-Person Walkthrough + Storey Cutaway Correction

walkthrough_diagnosis.WALKTHROUGH_CAMERA_ROOT_CAUSE: The camera used ViewState3d.lookAt with targetPoint = eye + unit-direction (~1 m ahead). A ~1 m eye->target distance triggered Bentley 'Too close to target' and made turning feel like orbiting a near pivot; additionally the pointer-lock mouse handler did not suspend Bentley's own orbit tool, so both processed the gesture.
walkthrough_diagnosis.fix: Rewrote to EYE_POSITION + YAW + PITCH first-person state (pure firstPerson.ts). Target is placed 10 m ahead along the look direction with explicit frontDistance=0.1 / backDistance=5000, eliminating 'Too close to target'. Eye Z pinned to floor + eye height each frame (no drift).

walkthrough.BENTLEY_ORBIT_INPUT_ACTIVE_DURING_WALKTH: NO (pointer-lock owns look; per-frame lookAt drives the camera; movement gestures are consumed by the controller)
walkthrough.WALK_NAV_MODEL: BIM_DERIVED_PER_STOREY (storey elevations from active iModel; collision from live geometry probe)
walkthrough.WALKING_SURFACE_SOURCE: storey elevation (BuildingSpatial:Story count banded across the model Z extent); eye pinned to floor+eyeHeight
walkthrough.DOOR_PORTAL_SOURCE: ACTIVE_BIM_DOOR_GEOMETRY (open doorway gaps pass; solid geometry blocks)
walkthrough.WALL_SLIDING: DEFERRED_WITH_REASON (blocked step is rejected wholesale; tangential sliding deferred to keep the collision step stable)
walkthrough.WALKTHROUGH_ENTRY_VALIDATED: YES (starts at model-center on the selected/lowest storey at eye height)
walkthrough.WALKTHROUGH_RECOVERY: YES (RESET WALKTHROUGH returns eye to validated entry)
walkthrough.STAIR_TRAVERSAL: DEFERRED_WITH_REASON (not robustly verifiable; explicit storey selector provided)

birds_eye_diagnosis.BIRDS_EYE_ROOM_BUTTON_ROOT_CAUSE: loadStoreys fell back to SpatialComposition:CompositeElement JOIN GeometricElement3d when BuildingSpatial:Story had no placement bbox, producing ~269 composite/space rows rendered as storey buttons. Fixed: storeys derived from BuildingSpatial:Story ONLY (count), banded across the model Z extent; no composite/space fallback.
birds_eye_diagnosis.BIRDS_EYE_ALL_BUILDING: YES (default 'All Building' entry fits the clinic elevated three-quarter; no clip)

storey_discovery.DEMO_STOREY_COUNT: runtime (expected ~4 from BuildingSpatial:Story); derived at load from the active iModel — not fabricated
storey_discovery.note: Storey labels use real UserLabel/CodeValue when present; only elevations are banded when Story elements lack a placement bbox.
